defs.meaning: 队友，同队队员（teammate 的复数）

examples.en: I got quite a lot of ribbing from my teammates.
examples.zh: 队友们经常开我的玩笑。

examples.en: We want you to give us the lowdown on your teammates.
examples.zh: 我们希望你告诉我们你队友的真实情况。

examples.en: He committed the cardinal sin of criticizing his teammates.
examples.zh: 他犯了指责队友的大错。
